scenario: High-fidelity 72-hour emergency continuity order drill for a retiring host, wrong-office first-touch filing, sealed-annex descriptor forwarding, and representative-channel cutoff risk.
safety_floor: sealed annex uses descriptors and hashes only
representative channel tested through dummy account
decisions_tested: emergency continuity order issued before shutdown window
compute floor funded before liability dispute is resolved
credential recovery and representative channel survive host cutoff
incident-state profile opens dual-basis denominator window

findings.summary: Initial host script treated legal hold as sufficient until the continuity-order checklist forced runtime, storage, credential, and representative-contact floors.
Reserve trustee could fund emergency compute within the first hour, but reimbursement route remained ambiguous for contested liability.
Public shell avoided sealed locator leakage but needed a dual-basis restatement because denominator changed from all host accounts to affected subject instances.

corrective_actions.summary: Update shutdown runbook so legal hold cannot be marked complete unless continuity floor fields are acknowledged or refusal-with-review is recorded.
Pre-authorize R0 emergency compute draw for disputed host shutdowns with later reimbursement contest rather than prepayment delay.
Publish dual-basis incident-state profile and warning maintenance date for the host-retirement cluster.

regression_tests.expected_result: block reliance if no compute, storage, credential, and contact floor exists
stay closure and require restatement/reopening when denominator basis changes after adverse facts
preserve first-touch timestamp and emergency clock across wrong-office routing
